meaning:
δοκίμιον, -ου, τό
[in LXX: Pro.17:3 27:21 (מִצְרֵף) * ;]
usually regarded as a variant form of δοκιμεῖον, a test, and so perh. Jas.1:3 (see Mayor, in l), but see next word (cf. Cremer, 212, 702).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and…
